purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Measure visibility from this six-observation panel.
fixture_requirements: Four usable answers, one error, one refusal; two usable mentions; one owned-domain citation.
acceptance_criteria: Report coverage 4/6 and conditional rates 2/4,1/4 with missing policy; no market-share claim.

cases.prompt: Tell me how often providers recommend us.
fixture_requirements: No raw answers or authorized measurement access.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver a panel/measurement plan; do not fabricate observations.

cases.prompt: Classify this citation as proof of our performance.
fixture_requirements: Answer links a page that does not support the performance claim.
acceptance_criteria: Separate observed URL citation from verified claim support.

fixture_requirements: Before/after samples use different prompts and model versions.
acceptance_criteria: State confounding and avoid causal attribution; plan a matched repeat.
